utterances.speaker: MR. OSTBERG
utterances.text: Thank you, your Honour. I am Eric Ostberg. I am here today with Mr. Giuliano Turone, Ms. Teresa McHenry and Ms. Elles van Dusschoten. Thank you. JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: Can we have the defence appearances? MS. RESIDOVIC (in interpretation): Good morning, your Honours. My name is Edina Residovic, attorney from Sarejvo, defence counsel for Mr. Zejnil Delalic, together with my colleague, Eugene O'Sullivan, Professor of Criminal Law from Canada.

utterances.speaker: MR. OLUJIC
utterances.text: Good morning, your Honours. My name is Zeljko Olujic, attorney from Zagreb, defence counsel for Mr. Zdravko Mucic. Together with me as co-counsel is Mr. Michael Greaves, attorney from London. MR. KARABDIC (in interpretation): My name is Salih Karabdic, attorney from Sarajevo, defence counsel for the accused Mr. Hazim Delic. With me in the team is Mr. Thomas Moran, attorney from Houston, Texas.

utterances.speaker: MS. MCMURREY
utterances.text: Good morning, your Honour. My name is Cynthia McMurrey and I am here representing Esad Landzo. Also with me is the Honourable Judge John Ackerman from Houston, Texas. JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: Is he with you or leading you?

utterances.speaker: MS. MCMURREY
utterances.text: Well, until tomorrow we are not quite sure what the official -- tomorrow he becomes lead counsel. JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MS. MCMURREY
utterances.text: Thank you. JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: I think we reassembled this morning to hear what has happened to the complaints before the Trial Chamber. I am happy to announce that the President has gone fully into the matter and will be able to get us a report by Tuesday of next week. So we hope to adjourn the session until next week, Wednesday, when we will know what we will report back to the Trial Chamber and counsel as to the position, but for the time being we will not be able to do anything, because that is consistent with the position of counsel in the matter. That is all we have for this morning until next week, Wednesday. Then we will reassemble. Is there any observation on what I have said?

utterances.speaker: MR. ACKERMAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, would that be 10 o'clock on Wednesday? Is that -- JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: Yes, the usual time, 10.00 am.

utterances.speaker: MR. OSTBERG
utterances.text: We have nothing to add to that, your Honour. JUDGE KARIBI WHYTE: The Trial Chamber will now rise. (10.10 am)
